title: Signal: Operating-system command executed through CALL SYSTEM in fortran — review required
scope: Single-line match on CALL SYSTEM in fortran.
limitations: Lexical: matches CALL SYSTEM; EXECUTE_COMMAND_LINE is out of scope.

examples.line: # audit: CALL SYSTEM("convert " // TRIM(user_file) // " out.png") present
# verified: CALL EXECUTE_COMMAND_LINE("convert in.png out.png", WAIT=.TRUE.)

fpNotes: A constant command in a build script is the accepted false positive.
